title: Keep source-membership projection derivation within the ledger's admitted capacity
outcome: A valid admitted exchange history can rebuild and verify its source-membership projections without exhausting a smaller aggregate reader budget.
acceptance: Source-membership derivation supports histories within the ledger's admitted record and byte limits without charging repeated binding reads against an incompatible whole-history budget; malformed or excessive input still refuses safely.

A meaningful behavior check demonstrates successful derivation at a history size or byte shape that previously exhausted the derivation budget, and preserves damaged-chain refusal and correct rebuilt membership.
